setup.title: Create the secret notes vault
setup.help: Secret notes are encrypted with a password only you know and kept in the Keychain — never in Devdy's database. No AI session, MCP tool or Remote Control can read them; you open the vault here.

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.help: If you forget the vault password, this key is the only way to open the vault. Write it down or keep it in a password manager — it is shown only this once. Any earlier recovery key no longer works.
recovery.warning: Without the password and this key, the notes cannot be recovered.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.help: {n} secret notes. Enter the vault password to open them.

password.title: Change password
password.afterRecovery: Opened with the recovery key: set a new password
password.changed: Password changed: the vault was re-encrypted with a new key
password.help: The vault is re-encrypted with a new key and you get a new recovery key: the old password and recovery key stop working.

merge.help: {n} notes come from another vault (another device or a backup). Enter that vault's password to merge them.
merge.password: Password or recovery key of the other vault

pending: {n} notes are waiting for their vault to sync to this device.
emptyHint: Click “+ New”, or move a note here with “Make secret” in the Notes window.
newMeta: Encrypted into the vault when you save
autoLock: Locks after {n} min idle, on screen lock or sleep
contentPlaceholder: Secret content (only you can read it)
editHint: {save} to save · {esc} to cancel · up to 64 KB
copied: Copied — cleared from the clipboard in {n} s
revealHint: Revealed content hides after {n} s or when the window loses focus. Copy keeps it to this Mac and clears it after 30 s or when the vault locks — but while it is on the clipboard, any program on this Mac (AI agents included) can read it.
noSelection: Pick a secret note, or create one. They never reach AI sessions, MCP tools or Remote Control.

delete.title: Delete secret note?
delete.message: "{title}" will be deleted from the vault on every synced device.

makeSecret.title: Move this note into the vault?
makeSecret.message: The note becomes a secret note and is deleted from Devdy's database. Copies made before stay where they are: session logs and transcripts that read it, earlier backups, and other synced devices until they sync.
makeSecret.done: Moved into the secret notes vault
makeSecret.needUnlock: Unlock the vault in the Secret notes window, then try again.
makeSecret.needVault: Create the vault in the Secret notes window, then try again.

errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.vault_throttled: Too many attempts: try again in {n} s.
errors.too_large: Too long: secret notes hold up to 64 KB.
errors.remote_denied: Secret notes are only available on this machine.
errors.clipboard_unsupported: Copy is not supported on this system.
